name: Little CMS (LittleCMS) 2 - lcms2.dll (x64, MSVC, float32 ctypes use)

license.name: MIT (Copyright (c) 2023 Marti Maria Saguer)
license.note: Upstream root has no COPYING file; LICENSE (MIT) is the license text shipped with the source.

installed_binary.export_mechanism: __declspec(dllexport) via CMS_DLL_BUILD (CMSAPI in include/lcms2.h); x64 Release project has no .def file
installed_binary.reproducibility_note: Built from the pinned archive; the PE timestamp/PDB GUID make a byte-identical rebuild unlikely, so the sha256 above identifies this exact artifact.

runtime_dependencies.c_runtime: Static /MT (MultiThreaded) CRT: no VCRUNTIME140.dll, MSVCP140.dll, or UCRT api-ms-win-crt redistributable needed at runtime
runtime_dependencies.host_requirements: Windows x64 with KERNEL32 (any supported Windows 10/11). Loaded from CPython 3.12.15 64-bit via ctypes.CDLL. No PATH or registry changes needed.

steps: tar.exe -tzf <archive> (checked: single top dir Little-CMS-lcms2.17, no absolute or .. paths); tar.exe -xzf <archive> -C .tools/lcms

cmd.exe /d /c ""C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && msbuild .tools\lcms\Little-CMS-lcms2.17\Projects\VC2022\lcms2_DLL\lcms2_DLL.vcxproj /nologo /m /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64 /v:minimal"   (environment is local to this cmd subprocess; host PATH untouched)
dumpbin /exports|/dependents /headers on the installed DLL (exports and KERNEL32-only imports verified)

validation.transform_format: TYPE_RGB_FLT (0x44001C) in and out, float32 RGB sRGB->sRGB, 4096 fractional random samples plus awkward fractions
validation.non_identity_control: sRGB white -> XYZ D50 (0.9642, 1.0, 0.8249) via cmsCreateXYZProfile, TYPE_XYZ_FLT 0x49001C
